zh.summary: 更新设置和更新流程现在能清楚区分 DSH-Portable 与官方 DeepSeek Harness。
highlights: 设置页可分别开启或手动检查产品更新与官方内核更新，两个启动检查都继续默认关闭。
修复托盘检查完成后仍显示“正在检查”的状态问题，并为等待选择与实际安装提供独立状态。
官方 DeepSeek Harness 可在完整跨平台成品验收通过后独立更新，不必等待下一次 Portable 功能版本。
Windows、macOS 与 Linux 共享同一份更新偏好和迁移规则，旧设置会自动保留。

en.summary: Update settings and flows now distinguish DSH-Portable from the official DeepSeek Harness core.
highlights: Settings can enable or run product and official-core checks independently; both startup checks remain off by default.
The tray no longer stays on Checking after the network request finishes; decisions and installation have separate states.
Official DeepSeek Harness builds can ship after full cross-platform product acceptance without waiting for another Portable feature release.
Windows, macOS, and Linux now share the same update preferences and migration behavior, preserving existing settings.
